'''Follow the White Rabbit Ewok Deck 2.0''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Follow the White Rabbit]]
* '''Published:''' 6 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Ewok Village|Endor-L-endorewokvillage.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Ewok Village
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Endor Ewok Village Rabbit LS EwokDeck.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My newer versoin of my ewok deck.

== Strategy ==

Strike Planning gets Crix Madine and Solo, Madine gets Chewie, Chewie gets Lumat and Wuta, Wuta gets Chief Chirpa's Hut. Im just going to luck with getting Luke, Ackbar, Threepio and Daughter of Skywalker.

I added Ackbar and Home 1 just so I can get at least one air support.

I know 29 characters sounds like a lot, but its really good.

[Moderator's Note]
RST- Rebel Strike Team
TIGIH- There is Good in Him
